'''Alexei Vladimirovich Yablokov''' ({{langx|ru|Алексей Владимирович Яблоков}}; 3 October 1933 – 10 January 2017) was a Soviet and Russian biologist, environmentalist and politician. He helped found [[Greenpeace]] of the USSR and advised President [[Boris Yeltsin]] on the environment in the early 1990s.<ref name="rferl">{{cite web |title=Russian Environmentalist, Politician Aleksei Yablokov Dead At 83 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-environmentalist-politician-yablokov-dead/28225469.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref><ref name="bellona">{{cite web |date=January 10, 2017 |title=Alexei Yablokov, grandfather of Russian environmentalism, dies at 83 |url=https://bellona.org/news/nuclear-issues/2017-01-alexei-yablokov-grandfather-of-russian-environmentalism-dies-at-83 |publisher=[[Bellona Foundation]] |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref> From 2005 he led the Green Russia faction of the opposition party [[Yabloko]].<ref name="ras">{{cite web |date=January 11, 2017 |title=Памяти Алексея Владимировича Яблокова |trans-title=In memory of Alexei Vladimirovich Yablokov |language=ru |url=http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=c7ebeb56-53fb-4648-884f-df17ae16a953 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170116180144/http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=c7ebeb56-53fb-4648-884f-df17ae16a953 |archive-date=January 16, 2017 |url-status=dead |publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref> He was the lead author of ''[[Chernobyl: Consequences of the Catastrophe for People and the Environment]]''.<ref name="bellona" />

== Scientific career ==
Yablokov was born in Moscow on 3 October 1933 and graduated from the biology faculty of [[Moscow State University]] in 1956.<ref name="biobib">{{cite book |title=Алексей Владимирович Яблоков |trans-title=Alexei Vladimirovich Yablokov |language=ru |series=Материалы к биобиблиографии учёных |publisher=Nauka |location=Moscow |year=2008}}</ref> His research concerned whales, dolphins and pinnipeds and the ways they adapt to life in the water.<ref name="ras" /> Out of his analyses of variation in animal populations grew two research directions of his own making, population morphology and the phenetics of natural populations.<ref name="ras" /> A textbook of evolutionary theory he wrote in 1969 with [[Nikolay Timofeev-Ressovsky]] and [[Nikolay Vorontsov]] ran through several editions.<ref name="biobib" />

From 1969 Yablokov headed a laboratory at the Koltsov Institute of Developmental Biology in Moscow. He took his doctorate in 1966, became a professor in 1976, and in 1984 the Soviet Academy of Sciences elected him a corresponding member.<ref name="biobib" /> His output ran to some 500 publications, 26 of them books.<ref name="ras" />

== Government service ==
In 1988 Yablokov helped found Greenpeace of the USSR and led it until 1991.<ref name="rferl" /> A seat in the Soviet [[Congress of People's Deputies of the Soviet Union|Congress of People's Deputies]] followed in 1989, along with the deputy chairmanship of the Supreme Soviet's ecology committee.<ref name="biobib" /> Yeltsin made him state counsellor for ecology and health in August 1991 and his environmental adviser a year later.<ref name="ukaz1991">{{cite web |date=August 14, 1991 |title=Указ Президента РСФСР «О Государственном советнике РСФСР по экологии и здравоохранению» |trans-title=Decree of the President of the RSFSR on the State Counsellor of the RSFSR for Ecology and Health Care |language=ru |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1220895 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130731005322/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1220895 |archive-date=July 31, 2013 |url-status=dead |publisher=Kremlin.ru |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref><ref name="ukaz1992">{{cite web |date=August 8, 1992 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации № 841 «О советнике Президента Российской Федерации по вопросам экологии и охраны здоровья» |trans-title=Decree of the President of the Russian Federation No. 841 on the Adviser to the President on Ecology and Health Protection |language=ru |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1230980 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130731012901/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1230980 |archive-date=July 31, 2013 |url-status=dead |publisher=Kremlin.ru |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref>

In that post Yablokov oversaw a government report that disclosed decades of Soviet dumping of radioactive waste at sea. The disclosure brought Russia more than $3 billion in international assistance for cleanup work.<ref name="bellona" /> From 1993 to 1997 he chaired the ecological security commission of the [[Security Council of Russia]].<ref name="ukaz1993">{{cite web |date=July 13, 1993 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации № 1035 «Об образовании Межведомственной комиссии Совета безопасности Российской Федерации по экологической безопасности» |trans-title=Decree of the President of the Russian Federation No. 1035 establishing the Interdepartmental Commission of the Security Council for Ecological Security |language=ru |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1181546 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130731014104/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1181546 |archive-date=July 31, 2013 |url-status=dead |publisher=Kremlin.ru |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref><ref name="ukaz1997">{{cite web |date=September 19, 1997 |title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации № 1037 «О межведомственных комиссиях Совета Безопасности Российской Федерации» |trans-title=Decree of the President of the Russian Federation No. 1037 on the interdepartmental commissions of the Security Council |language=ru |url=http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1151340 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130731014653/http://graph.document.kremlin.ru/page.aspx?1151340 |archive-date=July 31, 2013 |url-status=dead |publisher=Kremlin.ru |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref>

== Later politics ==
Yablokov founded the Green Russia party in 2005 and, once it merged into Yabloko, led its faction there until his death.<ref name="ras" /><ref name="rferl" /> In 2011 he ran third on Yabloko's list for parliament.<ref name="vesti">{{cite web |date=September 11, 2011 |title=Список «Яблока» возглавили Явлинский, Митрохин и Яблоков |trans-title=Yavlinsky, Mitrokhin and Yablokov head Yabloko's list |language=ru |url=http://www.vesti.ru/doc.html?id=566476 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110924071935/http://www.vesti.ru/doc.html?id=566476 |archive-date=September 24, 2011 |url-status=dead |publisher=Vesti |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref> Three years later he signed an appeal against Russia's [[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|annexation of Crimea]].<ref name="novaya">{{cite news |date=March 13, 2014 |title=Обращение инициативной группы по проведению Конгресса интеллигенции «Против войны, против самоизоляции России, против реставрации тоталитаризма» |trans-title=Appeal of the initiative group for the Congress of Intelligentsia "Against war, against Russia's self-isolation, against the restoration of totalitarianism" |language=ru |url=https://www.novayagazeta.ru/news/2014/03/13/97897-obraschenie-initsiativnoy-gruppy-po-provedeniyu-kongressa-intelligentsii-171-protiv-voyny-protiv-samoizolyatsii-rossii-protiv-restavratsii-totalitarizma-187-i-pismo-deyateley-kultury-v-podderzhku-pozitsii-vladimira-putina-po-ukraine-i-krymu |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170730123028/https://www.novayagazeta.ru/news/2014/03/13/97897-obraschenie-initsiativnoy-gruppy-po-provedeniyu-kongressa-intelligentsii-171-protiv-voyny-protiv-samoizolyatsii-rossii-protiv-restavratsii-totalitarizma-187-i-pismo-deyateley-kultury-v-podderzhku-pozitsii-vladimira-putina-po-ukraine-i-krymu |archive-date=July 30, 2017 |newspaper=[[Novaya Gazeta]] |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref> Alexei Yablokov died in Moscow on 10 January 2017.<ref name="rferl" /><ref name="afp">{{cite web |title=Father of Russian Environmental Movement Dies |url=https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/223571-father-of-russian-environmental-movement-dies |agency=[[Agence France-Presse]] |website=Naharnet |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref><ref name="ras" />

== Honours ==
Yablokov became a foreign honorary member of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1996 and held a [[The Pew Charitable Trusts|Pew]] fellowship in marine conservation from 1994.<ref name="aaas">{{cite web |title=Alexey Vladimirovich Yablokov |url=https://www.amacad.org/person/alexey-vladimirovich-yablokov |publisher=[[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref><ref name="pew">{{cite web |title=Alexey V. Yablokov, Ph.D. |url=https://www.pew.org/en/projects/marine-fellows/fellows-directory/1994/alexey-yablokov |publisher=The Pew Charitable Trusts |access-date=August 11, 2026}}</ref> He also won the Karpinsky Prize, the [[Nuclear-Free Future Award]] and a gold medal of the Royal Geographical Society.<ref name="ras" />
